policy: F2 v2 seed 2207 final checkpoint, fixed throughout every collection
scope: Matched-work throughput only. Replays are not new learning evidence. No final reserved data, public server or larger learning campaign.
correctness: Exact actions, request IDs, features, outcomes, phases and row linkage across serial/batched collection. Float outputs atol/rtol 3e-6; original PPO update/Adam states atol 3e-6 rtol 3e-5. Fail rather than skip a mismatching game.
metal: Separate Python 3.12, jax/jaxlib 0.4.34 and jax-metal 0.1.1 compatibility probe. Require actual Metal backend and matching policy/sampler/update outputs before full-game timing. No silent CPU fallback. CPU control must use the same isolated runtime for device-only comparisons.
